title: Chatticus deploys ChatticusComputers in the customer account
description:
**Phase 1 of 5.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing — `chatticus-2f2d87` documented the live refuse
- **Unblocks:** `chatticus-3e72dc` (terminal, browser, files, approvals, spend, relocate) and any honest claim that a customer computer starts

---

## Why this exists

F-computer (`chatticus-2f2d87`) live on development: ComputerWorker **assumed** `ChatticusOrganizationComputerRole` in `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID`, then `DescribeStacks(ChatticusComputers)` failed because that stack is not deployed in the customer account. **Zero `RunTask` in both accounts.** Anthus `ChatticusComputers` desiredCount stayed 0. Refuse-not-fallback held.

The published role (`infra/customer-role.yml`, unmodified) already allows `cloudformation:CreateStack` / `UpdateStack` / `DescribeStacks` on `stack/ChatticusComputers*/*`, plus ECS, ECR, VPC, logs, and `iam:CreateRole` for `ChatticusComputers*`. ComputerWorker **does not CreateStack**. That is this card.

## Who creates what (do not rediscover)

| Asset | Who | How |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cross-account IAM role | Customer | Published template (done, unmodified) |
| `ChatticusComputers` (VPC, cluster, task def, ECR repo, logs, task role) | **Chatticus under the assumed role** | `CreateStack` already in the published policy |
| Computer image `:dev` in that ECR | **Chatticus under the assumed role** | `PutImage` already allowed; customer does not docker-push |
| Snapshot bucket in the customer account | **Chatticus, inside `ChatticusComputers`** (or another `ChatticusComputers*` stack name) | Published CFN resource filter is `ChatticusComputers*` only. A customer stack named `ChatticusSnapshots` would be a **template change** (`chatticus-8a25af`). Anthus `ChatticusSnapshots` stays Anthus-managed. |

Do **not** ask the customer to run a second template for this. Do **not** `cdk deploy` Anthus `ChatticusComputers` into the customer account from the Anthus CLI. Do **not** `cdk deploy --all`. Do **not** destroy Anthus `ChatticusSnapshots` or `ChatticusComputers`. Do **not** `members seed`. Anthus desiredCount stays 0.

## Live constraints from `2f2d87`

- Map `DescribeStacks` `ClientError` (missing stack) to `OrganizationComputerProvisioningError` so ComputerWorker logs the reason (today nack swallows the body).
- Kernel `enqueue_computer_continuation` is the labeled operator path to reach ComputerWorker while the host is stopped. `POST .../resume` while stopped is `ComputerNotReadyError` — do not treat that as this card.
- Test human messages via kernel `post_channel_message` (live SQS). Do not wait on the UI.

## Done when

`ChatticusComputers` exists in `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID` because Chatticus created it under the assumed role; the `:dev` image is in that account's ECR; one computer-requiring turn reaches **customer-account `RunTask`**; Anthus `RunTask` count stays 0 and Anthus desiredCount stays 0. If a template change is required, stop and record it on `chatticus-8a25af` — do not silent-edit `customer-role.yml`.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan reviewed, **not authorized**. Worktree `/tmp/chatticus-82dab7-customer-computers` on `feat/customer-computers-stack-82dab7` is correct (not the primary clone, at `cc8eaf6`). Lazy one-shot inside `OrganizationComputerHostStarter`, Gherkin-first, refuse-not-fallback, and the 8a25af STOP rule stand.

Holes to close before implement (inversion):

1. **Do not put an S3 bucket in this slice’s template.** `customer-role.yml` has no `s3:*`. CreateStack of a bucket will `CREATE_FAILED`. 82dab7 DoD is customer `RunTask`, not hydrate. Omit the bucket; ephemeral live root. Bucket + `s3:*` is a customer-visible follow-up on `8a25af` before the file-actions row of `3e72dc`. Do not wait for a live failure to discover a hole we can read in the YAML now.

2. **Do not copy `:dev` layers through the 60s ComputerWorker Lambda.** Chromium image will not finish in one (or many) 60s nacks. Customer task definition pulls **Anthus** `:dev`. Anthus ECR repo policy allows the customer execution role (Anthus-side, not customer-visible). Customer ECR replica is out of this card. Live preflight: Anthus `:dev` already exists (`computer/push-computer-image.sh`); if missing, that is an Anthus ops stop, not a customer copy.

3. **`CreateStack` TemplateBody max is 51,200 bytes.** A CDK VPC+ECS template often exceeds it. After synth, measure. Over the limit: `TemplateURL` to an Anthus **S3 object URL** (CFN cannot fetch CloudFront — that is why customer-role is GET then `--template-body`). Under the limit: `TemplateBody` is fine. CI must fail if synth drifts from the committed artifact.

4. **`CreateStack` must pass `CAPABILITY_IAM` and `CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM`.** Omitted from the plan; IAM roles are in the stack.

5. **No production auto-provision flag.** Scenario 3 is a Gherkin fake that cannot `CreateStack` (test double), not `CHATTICUS_*_AUTOPROVISION=0` in Lambda. Two products is a defect.

Revise PLAN.md in the existing worktree. Do not implement. Do not CreateStack. Do not edit `customer-role.yml`.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Plan re-reviewed and **authorized** with one hole closed.

Worktree verified: `/tmp/chatticus-82dab7-customer-computers` on `feat/customer-computers-stack-82dab7` (not the primary clone). Five prior holes are closed: no S3 in this template, no Lambda image copy, TemplateBody 51,200 gate, both IAM capabilities, test-double refusal (no prod flag).

**Closed on authorize:** Anthus ECR `:dev` pull is **per customer `aws_account_id` at provision time**, not a synth-time list of accounts in CDK. ComputerWorker (Anthus creds) merges that account into the Anthus `ComputerImage` repository policy (account root principal is enough; the customer execution role already has ECS pull APIs). A hardcoded lab account in CDK would be a second product. Lambda needs `ecr:GetRepositoryPolicy` / `ecr:SetRepositoryPolicy` on the Anthus repo only — not customer-visible.

Do not edit `customer-role.yml`. Do not CreateStack until Gherkin is red for the right reasons. Tear down the worktree only after this card is closed and the product PR is on `develop`.

comments.text:
Closing. DoD met live on development after #312 (`9826f2b`, ThinTurn [34147142105](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Chatticus/actions/runs/34147142105)).

Kernel path (standing rule): attempt 2 turn `baddaae0-…` **dispatch_ok** host-start gen 29 (~111 s). AssumeRole yes. CreateStack `ChatticusComputers` in `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID` once (TemplateBody, both IAM capabilities, no S3). Customer `RunTask` yes (inferred: `mark_host_start_dispatched` without rollback). Anthus `RunTask` **0**; desiredCount **0**. Image is Anthus `:dev` via repo policy, not a customer ECR replica.

Desk root cannot AssumeRole into the member account, so customer CloudTrail/`DescribeStacks` were not read directly. That is the known lab-root limitation, not a product hole.

Elapsed ~111 s (succeeding attempt) / ~280 s (first nack-while-provisioning). **Do not fold into ~19 min.**

Unblocks `chatticus-3e72dc`. Snapshot bucket still `8a25af` before file-actions.

**Reopened.** `3e72dc` Layer B (lab IAM user, not root) `DescribeStacks(ChatticusComputers)` in `CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_ID`: stack does not exist; ECS cluster list empty. Closure had inferred CreateStack/RunTask from ComputerWorker dispatch because management root cannot AssumeRole. Direct evidence now contradicts that DoD.

Investigate first: `list-stacks` including `DELETE_COMPLETE` / `ROLLBACK_COMPLETE`, stack events, CloudTrail `DeleteStack`/`CreateStack`. Do not CLI-create the stack. Restore only via the product CreateStack path after the cause is named.
